rules.note: Not listed in the official requirements.
Photo attached to the application form: 4.5 x 3.5 cm, taken within 6 months, upper body, full face, no hat. Write your name and nationality on the back.

Certificate of graduation from upper secondary school (or of prospective graduation). University students and graduates also need the university certificate or an enrolment certificate. Attested copies are accepted.
Transcripts for all school years of upper secondary school (and of university if you attend or attended one), showing the grade scale and grades. Japanese or English, or add a translation.
Letter from a class teacher or the principal of the last school you attended, issued by that school or university. Any format is accepted.
The 2027 Certificate of Health form, filled in and signed by a medical doctor.
Only if you have a Japanese or English certificate showing your name and level or score, issued within the last 2 years. Submit copies.

Direct Placement Preference Form: only if you choose Social Sciences and Humanities and are eligible for direct placement, or want direct placement in any field. Submitted after you pass the first screening.
